name: Twitching Antenna
summary: In the southern Barrens, silithid antennae still twitch after they are cut free. Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo seeks them as proof of a young warrior’s speed and skill in combat before the nerves go still.

sections.title: Proof of the Hunt
sections.body: Silithid Grubs, Swarmers, Harvesters, and Creepers carry antennae that twitch after they are cut from the head. The spasms fade soon after the insects are slain. A young warrior must hunt silithid in the southern wastes and hurry back across the scrublands while the antennae still twitch. Bringing them back in time tests both speed and skill, making the hunt a rite of passage for Horde warriors.

sections.title: The Threat in the South
sections.body: The silithid antennae also point to a threat that troubles Camp Taurajo’s hunters. Silithid are not native to the Barrens, and their new burrowing mounds at the Field of Giants unsettle the camp. Ruga Ragetotem wants the specimens to study the danger and prepare Horde warriors for the alien menace moving into the plains.

faq.answer: Silithid Grubs, Harvesters, Swarmers, and Creepers around the Field of Giants in the southern Barrens carry the antennae.

faq.q: Why do the antennae have to be twitching?
aliases: trial at field of giants timer
faq.answer: The twitching shows the antennae were freshly cut. Ruga Ragetotem uses how quickly they go still to test an aspirant’s speed and combat skill across the wild terrain.

faq.q: Who is looking for these antennae?
faq.answer: Ruga Ragetotem, a tauren warrior at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, seeks the antennae for the Trial at the Field of Giants.

faq.q: Where is the Field of Giants?
faq.answer: The Field of Giants lies south of Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Massive skeletal remains rise from the earth there, with silithid hives around them.

angles.text: As a hunter, you track and slay silithid, then gather their antennae while they still twitch. The trial tests your speed, tracking, and skill in the field.
As a tauren, you know Camp Taurajo’s hunters see the silithid’s sudden arrival as a disturbance to the plains’ natural balance. Young braves must stay vigilant.

attribution: Trial at the Field of Giants
